content.text: In Nigeria, where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-what-nobody-tells-you-3|Stripe Alternatives]] is unavailable, digital creators can't collect payment for their ebooks, courses, and software. This is where Supabase steps in as the order database for digital stores. With Supabase and NOW[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-3|payments]], you can build a free digital store that accepts crypto payments, bypassing platform restrictions. While Stack 01 is a DIY solution deployed in 4-6 hours, Stack 02 is a fully managed Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deployed in 48 hours, providing end-to-end testing and 30-day support. To succeed, you need the right infrastructure in place. This guide shows you how to deploy a Supabase order database, configure payment and delivery pipelines, and scale your digital store.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Platforms like Stripe and Gumroad are often unavailable or restricted in certain countries or regions. This leaves digital creators in a bind, unable to collect payment for their products. Supabase and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-payments-what-actually-2|COREMERCH guide to nowpayments]] provide a sovereign solution, allowing creators to process payments directly, without relying on third-party platforms. By hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages and using NOWPayments for crypto payments, you can create a fully functional digital store, free from platform restrictions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Stack 02 — the Edge Commerce Stack — uses Cloudflare Pages for storefront hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend webhook handling, Supabase for order storage, Cloudflare R2 for product file delivery, and Resend for transactional email. The entire stack costs nothing per month up to significant volume thresholds — Cloudflare Workers provides 100,000 requests per day free, Supabase provides 500MB of PostgreSQL storage free, Cloudflare R2 provides 10GB storage and zero egress fees free, and Resend provides 3,000 emails per month free. SPF, DKIM, and DMARC are configured during COREMERCH deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The NOWPayments configuration sequence is the same regardless of which stack you are deploying. Create a NOWPayments account — no KYC required, no document upload, no bank account needed. Navigate to the wallet settings and add the wallet addresses for each cryptocurrency you want to accept. USDT on Tron and Bitcoin are the practical starting point for most creators in restricted markets. Generate an API key from the NOWPayments dashboard. Set the webhook endpoint URL in the NOWPayments IPN settings pointing to your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App. Set the webhook secret key — a string you generate that both NOWPayments and your backend know.
You can process payments directly with NOWPayments and Supabase, without relying on third-party platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Testing before promotion is not optional — it is the step that determines whether your store functions correctly under real conditions before real buyers encounter it. The test sequence has four steps. First: deploy the backend and confirm the webhook endpoint returns a valid response to a test HTTP POST. Second: configure the storefront and confirm the checkout displays correctly on desktop and mobile. Third: complete a real mainnet transaction with a small amount of actual crypto. Fourth: check your order database and confirm the order was logged correctly, the delivery email arrived, and the download link works.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The post-deployment ownership transfer is explicit in every COREMERCH deployment. When the build is complete and the end-to-end test passes, COREMERCH provides the credentials and configuration details for every component under the customer's accounts. The GitHub or Cloudflare repository is under the customer's account from the start. The Supabase or Google Sheets database is under the customer's account. The NOWPayments account is under the customer's email. COREMERCH removes collaborator access upon delivery. From that point, the store runs entirely under the customer's own accounts.

Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages? Yes, you can host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, using NOWPayments for crypto payments and Supabase as the order database. This setup provides a sovereign solution, allowing you to process payments directly, without relying on third-party platforms.
Supabase provides a powerful order database solution for digital stores.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for a more comprehensive solution, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which provides a fully managed deployment of Stack 02, including end-to-end testing and 30-day support. You can also visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore more products and services.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a Supabase order database, you'll need to: create a NOWPayments account and integrate it with Supabase, set up a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages site, configure your hosting settings, configure NOWPayments to work with Supabase, set up a webhook to trigger payment processing, and integrate your delivery pipeline with Supabase. Make sure to test your payment flow thoroughly before accepting real payments.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I create a NOWPayments account?
To create a NOWPayments account, simply sign up on their website and follow the registration process. This will give you a unique API key that you can use to integrate NOWPayments with Supabase.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?
Stack 01 is a DIY solution deployed in 4-6 hours, while Stack 02 is a fully managed Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deployed in 48 hours, providing end-to-end testing and 30-day support.
Can I use Supabase as my order database if I'm not technical?

While Supabase is a powerful tool, it does require some technical expertise to set up and configure. If you're not technical, you may want to consider hiring a developer to help you set up your order database.
How do I integrate NOWPayments with Supabase?
To integrate NOWPayments with Supabase, you'll need to create a webhook to trigger payment processing and configure your payment settings, including supported cryptocurrencies and transaction fees.
Can I use Supabase with other payment gateways?
Yes, you can use Supabase with other payment gateways, but NOWPayments provides a seamless integration with Supabase, making it the recommended choice.
With NOWPayments, you can accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies for payment.
